title: Multi-Step Equations | Algebra I, Unit 2, Lesson 3
description:
A four-step plan for any linear equation: distribute, combine like terms, move the variable terms to one side, then undo operations. Worked examples include variables on both sides and a tip for avoiding negative coefficients. Ends with a practice problem.
